Here’s a **step‑by‑step playbook** that’ll let you add a “star rating + review” feature to your product pages without writing a whole new backend. Everything relies on **Supabase** (the Firebase‑for‑PostgreSQL platform) and a few lines of JavaScript you can drop into an HTML page or a simple site builder like Squarespace, Wix, or WordPress (with JavaScript support). If you’re using a CMS that allows custom widgets or block‑code, that’s the place to put it. --- ## 1. Create a Supabase Project (Free Tier) 1. **Sign up** at (free tier has 5 k rows & 50 MB storage). 2. **Create a new project** → pick a name, password, and region. 3. Take note of the **API keys** in the `Project Settings → API` section: * `anon public` key * `service_role` key (you’ll only need this for server‑side changes; we’ll keep to the public key for front‑end). --- ## 2. Set Up Your Database ### 2.1 Create the “products” table (if you don’t have one) ```sql create table if not exists products ( id uuid primary key default uuid_generate_v4(), name text not null, description text, price numeric, created_at timestamp default now() ); ``` Add a few sample rows: ```sql insert into products(name) values ('Awesome Headphones', 'Cool sound', 120), ('Eco‑Friendly Water Bottle', 'Zero waste', 25); ``` > **Tip** – If your products already live elsewhere (Shopify, WooCommerce, etc.), you just need a **Unique product ID** that the front‑end can pass when creating reviews. ### 2.2 Create the “reviews” table ```sql create table if not exists reviews ( id uuid primary key default uuid_generate_v4(), product_id uuid references products(id) on delete cascade, rating integer not null check (rating between 1 and 5), review text, customer_name text, created_at timestamp default now() ); ``` ### 2.3 Set Row‑Level Security (RLS) & Policies We want *anyone* who can read reviews, but only the person who wrote it (or an admin) can delete/update. 1. **Enable RLS** on the `reviews` table (Project → Database → Tables → reviews → Row level security). 2. Add these policies: | Action | Policy | |--------|--------| | **INSERT** | `true` (anyone can create, but we’ll add a trick to bind the product ID) | | **SELECT** | `true` (read all reviews for any product) | | **UPDATE / DELETE** | `auth.uid() = person_id` (you’ll store the user’s ID if you use Supabase Auth later). For now we’ll skip update/delete – only admins can do that from the Supabase UI. | > **Important** – If you don’t want people to read reviews until you’ve approved them, you can keep read off and create a new column `approved boolean default false` and change the SELECT policy to `approved = true`. --- ## 3. Add the Front‑End Widget Below is **plain HTML & JavaScript** that you can place anywhere on your site. It uses the **Supabase JavaScript client** (`@supabase/supabase-js`), so you can load it from a CDN. ```html
